description: This file defines the BlockLibraryController class in Drupal, responsible for listing block plugins that can be added to layouts, including rendering logic, filtering, and building local actions.

classes.name: BlockLibraryController
classes.description: Controller class providing a list of block plugins for Drupal layouts, with methods for rendering block lists and building local actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for block management, context, routing, and local actions.

methods.name: listBlocks
methods.description: Renders a list of available blocks for a given theme, including filtering, sorting, and operation links.

methods.name: buildLocalActions
methods.description: Builds a list of local action links for the current route, wrapped in a <ul> element.
